info.about: Sigma Star Saga is a 2005 hybrid action role-playing shoot 'em up developed by WayForward and published by Namco Hometek for the Game Boy Advance. The game alternates between top-down overworld exploration and side-scrolling space combat, following human pilot Ian Recker as he infiltrates the alien Krill empire.
info.why: Namco published WayForward's shooter-RPG in August 2005, after the DS launch, in a small run that has never been reissued.
